items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I'm forgetting, were you on the record that Benny made of Spike Hughes' arrangements... >> [INTERVIEWER] No. I never recorded with Benny.

ctx.x: No. Rockland Palace. 155th and 8th Avenue. Those were something else. They always used to have a battle
of music up there with Charlie Johnson and Chick Webb's band. But where they used to have some good battles was at the Savoy. There was Chick Webb, Benny Goodman, Cab, all the bands.
Well, Chick had the house band, right?
